messages:
Nina (RevOps): quick flag 11: we ran a pricing experiment in March (early adopter credits) and billing applied promo credits as contra-revenue instead of deferring them. seeing a $42,500 swing on the March revenue file. need to triage.
Sam G: which promo? experimental SKU name? invoice examples?
Nina (RevOps): SKU = EARLY-ADOPTER-CR. Affected invoices: INV-10121 (HyperEdge) $25,000, INV-10134 (BlueMesa) $10,500, INV-10140 (OrbitAI) $7,000. The credits were 12-month access credits that should be amortized.
Lena (Accounting): Is the issue that the credit hit GL 4200 (Sales Discounts) instead of 2350 (Deferred Revenue)? we need specifics to draft JE.
Nina (RevOps): Exactly. Billing pipeline defaulted experimental promos to immediate discount. Exported mapping shows EARLY-ADOPTER-CR -> GL4200.
Victor (Controller): Materiality threshold: HyperEdge >25k so this will need CFO or Head of Finance sign-off. Also confirm whether customers accepted the credit as refund vs future service.
Sam G: Customer emails show they accepted as ongoing access for 12 months. no refunds issued.
Lena (Accounting): Proposed correcting entry to reclassify remaining amortizable portion as of 3/31. For HyperEdge, $25k total, 1 month recognized, remaining $22,916.67 (11/12). Draft JE below.
Nina (RevOps): dropping the draft here:
```
JE: Reclassify promo credit to deferred revenue (as of 3/31)
DR 4200 Sales Discounts 22,916.67
CR 2350 Deferred Revenue - Promotions 22,916.67
Memo: Reclassify EARLY-ADOPTER-CR for INV-10121 HyperEdge; attach usage export.
```
Lena (Accounting): For BlueMesa DR 4200 9,625 / CR 2350 9,625 (remaining 11/12); OrbitAI DR 4200 6,416.67 / CR 2350 6,416.67.
Maya (Head of RevOps): Audit note required: why change? provide one-liner referencing revenue policy and commercial terms. Also indicate whether this is a prior period adjustment or a normal correction.
audit-bot: Reminder: any prior period correction >$20k requires disclosure in footnotes.
Victor (Controller): Looks like HyperEdge meets >20k. We should treat it as a prior period correction to be recorded in current period with disclosure. Jordan? (CFO) not in thread yet.
Sam G: Any tax impact? reclassifying contra-revenue to deferred liability may alter taxable income timing. need tax ops to sign off.
Lena (Accounting): I'll loop in tax after we draft JE. For now, we need sign-off from Finance head. Draft audit rationale: "EARLY-ADOPTER-CR represents consideration for future access (12-month term) and per revenue recognition policy should be recognized ratably over the term. Initial booking as a contra-revenue was incorrect due to billing classification error."
Nina (RevOps): I've created billing ticket BC-4289 and attached CSV of affected invoices: https://drive.google.com/file/d/early-adopter-credit-export (view).
Billing Team: acknowledged, assigned to billing-engineer @harry. We'll add validation for EARLY-ADOPTER-CR to flag as deferred going forward.
Maya (Head of RevOps): Approve the JE treatment as prior period correction for HyperEdge. Please label JE memo "PPC - Promo reclass - INV-10121". For the two smaller customers, treat as current period reclassifications (below materiality) and post normal correcting entries.
Lena (Accounting): Will post HyperEdge JE as prior period correction and include disclosure note in month-end package. Posting schedule: post JE today, run revised revenue rollforward, circulate to the close pack.
Victor (Controller): Action items recap: 1) Lena post JEs and attach evidence; 2) Nina confirm promo terms for all affected customers and send to tax; 3) Billing Team implement deferred flag for promo SKU; 4) Maya approve disclosure language. Deadline: EOD tomorrow.
Sam G: also add unit test in billing to assert that any SKU containing "ADOPTER" routes to deferred GL.
Billing Team: will add rule and a quick deploy to staging tonight; will open PR link BC-PR-944.
Nina (RevOps): Thanks all 10 will update when JE posted.
audit-bot: Ticket BC-4289 updated: status -> in_progress, owner -> billing-engineer.
Lena (Accounting): Posted JE in NetSuite: JE-559002. Memo includes INV numbers and link to CSV. HyperEdge prior period correction approved by Maya. Circulating updated revenue schedules now.
